$comment: Per component: its style variants (id, name, purpose, the pattern it follows, its source and licence, the packs it is built in) and its motion (enter, hover, press, change, as motion.json names them). "default" is the component as it is drawn today; the other variants are seeded from docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md and each wave (the component's "wave") refines and builds them. A pack listed in "built" must have the variant in its code (the variant prop, the bx-v-<id> class on the web) and its gallery (an element with data-variant="<id>" in the component's section); VariantsCoverageTest checks it. How to add one: target-packs/components/styles/README.md.
